task.title: To remove a marked clause after Intelligent Discovery

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced and open the Agreement Document.

Extract data from the document using the Intelligent Discovery option and click Review Import Results. For more information on data extraction, see Extracting Agreement Data Using Intelligent Discovery.
In the Contracts pane, click Work tab and click Doc Clauses.
Select the incorrectly tagged clause and click the More button().
Click Delete on the confirmation dialog that appears.

postreq.p: Additionally, clauses and fields extracted by Intelligent Discovery are converted into smart clauses and fields. Upon check-in with reconciling, it will promote all marked clauses.
